people.description: who is in frame and what they're doing (no names, no guesses about identity)

story_beat_ideas.description: what moment of a trip story this photo could be (arrival, awe, quiet reflection...)

camera_move.description: best cinematic camera move to animate this photo (e.g. slow push-in, lateral parallax, tilt up)

animation_prompt.description: a 40-70 word image-to-video prompt describing subtle, realistic motion consistent with the photo; never change faces

caption_options.description: short documentary on-screen captions, max 7 words each

facts_to_verify.description: historical/place facts that would enrich narration, each phrased so it can be checked
